articles.title: Show HN: Docx-CLI – let agents edit your Word files safely
articles.summary: A new Command Line Interface (CLI) tool empowers AI agents like Claude and Codex to safely interact with .docx files. It enables them to read, edit, and comment on documents while maintaining full format fidelity. By outputting JSON-AST, the tool allows for precise, locator-based editing. This advancement significantly enhances AI's capabilities in sophisticated document processing and management.

articles.title: Russian attacks kill 27 before Ukraine ceasefire deadline
articles.summary: Russian forces launched deadly attacks in eastern Ukraine, killing at least 27 people, including 12 in a single strike. These intensified assaults occurred just hours before an open-ended midnight ceasefire was set to begin. This pre-ceasefire violence underscores the volatile nature of the conflict and the continued human cost despite attempts at de-escalation.

articles.title: Quantitative predictions of alpha-charmonium correlation functions in high-energy collisions
articles.summary: This research builds theoretical models to understand the interaction between helium nuclei (alpha particles) and charmonium particles. Using advanced quantum chromodynamics (QCD) and single-folding potential (SFP) approaches, scientists are calculating the forces involved. This fundamental work enhances our knowledge of subatomic particle behavior and the strong nuclear force, crucial for advancing theoretical physics.

articles.title: The output must be cleaned (with skill)
articles.summary: A new Claude skill, "clean-rspec-output," has been developed to streamline testing processes in Ruby on Rails development. This tool systematically removes unexpected or verbose output from RSpec test suites, allowing developers to focus solely on critical test results. This innovation aims to enhance efficiency and clarity in software quality assurance, benefiting those involved in technology and programming.

articles.title: Are microbes the future of pollution clean-up?
articles.summary: Environmental engineer Ludmilla Aristilde and her colleagues are developing innovative biotechnology-led solutions to combat pollution. Their research focuses on leveraging biological processes and tools to effectively mitigate environmental contaminants. This work aims to create sustainable methods for combating various forms of pollution, offering promising advancements in environmental remediation and sustainable resource management.

articles.title: Tribune Notebook: Willmar athletes earn Central Lakes honors
articles.summary: Carter Newberg has been elevated to the No. 1 singles position for the Willmar boys tennis team. This challenging role means he will consistently compete against the top players in the Central Lakes Conference. The move provides a significant opportunity for Newberg to develop his skills and leadership against strong regional competition, honing his performance under pressure.
